draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.12, the 113th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 8th of 19 at DT. He lasted until pick 158, well after his grade rank (113th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Ross Blacklock. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (84th percentile). College production: his final season (2020) ranked 3rd in sacks among the 19 DTs in his class with stats.
